snippet.title: Mirage Of Tower Trailer
snippet.description:
The Trailer to my upcoming game Mirage Of Tower (to be released: 2026 January 30). It's a platformer game by Arkhouse Telegraph.

*** some AI is used in the creation of this Trailer. Particularly: The music re-arrangement you hear. The fir trees on the background in one of the scenes.
